mustFix.location: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-260.draft.md, line 103, inside the 'Live remasurement at draft time:' block
mustFix.quotedDraftText: DR-G14 lead token remains `OPEN`; DR-118 remains `OPEN`.
mustFix.claim: The draft asserts, as a measured live-register fact, that DR-118's status token is `OPEN`. It is not.
mustFix.measuredTruth: Live file 08 at the draft's own cited digest e503b75b... carries DR-118 with status column (COL6 of the 7-column row) `**DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED**` — 'role list DECIDED (D-002 ...) and acceptance STRUCTURE decided (D-007 ...); per-row thresholds remain UNDECIDED (unlike DR-115)'. The token `OPEN` does not appear in that cell.
whyThisIsNotCosmetic: The register's condition-2 row states a disjoint partition of the same 32 slice-affecting rows: 5 `SATISFIED` + 24 `OPEN` + 1 `DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED` + 2 `PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW` = 32. DR-118 is that single DECIDED row. Reciting it as OPEN is arithmetically incompatible with the live tally the same draft relies on when it recites 'Condition 2 stays 5 of 32' — the draft would simultaneously imply 25 OPEN / 0 DECIDED and 24 OPEN / 1 DECIDED.

The DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED label is the carrier of the D-007 split: the role list and acceptance structure are decided, while per-row thresholds remain UNDECIDED. Flattening it to OPEN erases the decided half and, with it, the very annotation that D-007 item 9 required be stated on this row.

That same label is what keeps DR-118 ineligible for D-056 Class B SATISFIED while thresholds are design-undecided. Recording DR-118 as a plain OPEN row in append-only COORD misstates the eligibility posture of a row this decision is separately forbidden to SATISFY.
corroboration: D-213 — the adopted sibling decision on the same gate and the same occupancy family — is recorded with the reviewed recital 'DR-G14 remains OPEN, DR-117 remains OPEN, DR-118 remains DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED with thresholds undecided'. The established convention distinguishes the two tokens rather than merging them.
The D-236 adversarial review records 'DR-118 remains the single DECIDED row; DR-103, DR-117, DR-131, and DR-133 remain OPEN.'
The Stage A Claude review of harness v2 records 'Live file 08 DR-118 lead label is DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED.'

The subject artifact itself does not make this error: language-runtime-leftover-join.v5.json sets file08StatusToken to 'OPEN' scoped to registerRow 'DR-G14', and its OBL-DR118-NOT-RETARGETED obligation describes DR-118 only through its leftover standing, never as OPEN. reviewSummary: 32 attacks run, 31 refuted, 1 landed. The subject is unmoved at 0444 with the expected digest at both measurements, all 14 cited hex tokens reproduce byte-exactly, both Stage A reviews are 0444 ACCEPT 0/0 pinned to the live candidate, and the substantive posture of the draft is sound throughout: leftoverDesign stays [OBL-G14-FX-AUTHORING], the three DR-118 obligations are not stolen, every currency recital is correctly two-clause, the no-cell-edit branch is gapless and excludes D-236 in agreement with git history, and every prohibited mint, satisfaction, reopening, occupancy, and authorization is expressly disclaimed. One recital fails. Inside the 'Live remasurement at draft time' block — the block whose entire function is to assert measured live-register state — the draft says 'DR-118 remains `OPEN`'. Live file 08, at the digest the draft itself cites, carries DR-118 as `**DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED**`. This is not a synonym: the register's own condition-2 partition counts 24 OPEN and exactly 1 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED among the same 32 rows, so the recital contradicts the tally the draft relies on two sections later, and the DECIDED label is the carrier of the D-007 decided-role-list / undecided-thresholds split that keeps DR-118 off the D-056 Class B list. The adopted sibling D-213 recites the two tokens separately and correctly, which is the standard this draft departs from; the error looks like an unre-measured template carry-over from D-259, where the parallel row DR-112 genuinely is OPEN. The measured input is innocent — leftover-join.v5 scopes its 'OPEN' token to DR-G14 and never calls DR-118 open. Repair is one clause on one line and disturbs nothing else. OBJECT at 1 MUST-FIX.
